channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Breaking: US Nonfarm Payrolls rise by 57K in June vs. 110K expected
item.description: Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) in the United States (US) rose by 57K in June, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Thursday. This print followed the 129K increase (revised from 172K) recorded in May and fell short of the market expectation of 110K by a wide margin.

item.title: Euro: Labor resilience and ECB split shape outlook – BNY
item.description: BNY's Geoff Yu highlights that Sintra offered limited clarity on Euro area growth, but an emerging split within the European Central Bank (ECB) over further tightening points to easier financial conditions.

item.title: US Dollar: Near-term support with higher rate volatility – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes the US Dollar strengthened as lower Eurozone CPI, comments from Kevin Warsh, and anticipation of US Non-Farm Payrolls supported the currency.

item.title: Mexican Peso: Policy uncertainty caps nearshoring upside – Societe Generale
item.description: Dev Ashish at Societe Generale notes that MXN price action was relatively muted after the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) extension decision, indicating investors largely expected the outcome.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Possible Japan intervention caps gains near 216.00
item.description: GBP/JPY trades under pressure on Thursday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens across the board amid speculation that Japanese authorities may have intervened in the foreign exchange market after the Yen fell to a 40-year low against the US Dollar (USD) earlier this week.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Euro holds above 183.75 with bearish pressure mounting
item.description: The Euro (EUR) accelerated its decline against a strong Japanese Yen (JPY), which has rallied across the board on Thursday, without any clear reason to explain the move.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention uncertainty reshapes carry trades – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that iFlow data show clients turning underweight Japanese Yen (JPY) for the first time since Q4 2024, as USD/JPY’s climb and intervention fears had kept hedge ratios low.

item.title: United States Dollar Index slumps to near 101 in countdown to the US NFP data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) underperforms its major currency peers ahead of the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for June, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar strengthens against USD on weak US data ahead NFP
item.description: NZD/USD trades higher around 0.5680 on Thursday at the time of writing, up 0.16% on the day, as investors reduce their exposure to the US Dollar (USD) ahead of the release of the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: US Dollar: Constructive price action on jobs data – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that the Dollar sell-off after Kevin Warsh’s Sintra appearance has already been retraced, with markets concluding the new Fed Chair is comfortable letting data drive expectations.

item.title: Here's where Gold could head next after the WGC pencils in $5,000 as upside ceiling
item.description: Gold prices are expected to trade broadly stable in the second half of the year, seesawing within a 5% range from current levels of around $4,100 per troy ounce, according to analysts at the World Gold Council (WGC).

item.title: Euro: Downside bias builds into NFP against US Dollar – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that softer Euro-zone inflation has pushed EUR/USD below support at 1.1400, with yields falling and markets less confident of another ECB rate hike. The ECB’s “milder” scenario now looks more likely, reducing pressure to tighten further.

item.title: $4,000: Gold defends key support as traders await US NFP
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades on the front foot on Thursday as the US Dollar (USD) weakens amid rumors of a potential intervention by Tokyo after the Japanese Yen (JPY) hit a 40-year low earlier this week.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecasts: Nears weekly top at 1.1435 with bearish momentum easing
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades higher on Thursday against the US Dollar (USD) as traders trim USD longs ahead of the US Nonfarm Payrolls report, due later on the day.

item.title: Indian Rupee declines despite US Dollar underperforms ahead of NFP data
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) surrenders early gains and turns marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound surges against US Dollar ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades 0.5% higher to near 1.3340 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: US Dollar: Labor focus softens – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes that the US Nonfarm Payrolls release is unlikely to have the market impact it once did, even as recent JOLTS data point to improving hiring and fewer layoffs.

item.title: Euro weakens vs British Pound as softer Eurozone inflation, divided ECB weigh
item.description: EUR/GBP trades around 0.8550 on Thursday, down 0.21% on the day, as the Euro (EUR) remains under pressure against the British Pound (GBP) after another batch of data reinforced expectations of a more cautious European Central Bank (ECB).

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Dollar finds support at previous resistance area around 161.00
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) staged a sharp rebound against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, raising speculation about potential action by the Japanese Ministry of Finance (MoF).

item.title: Indian Rupee: State-bank selling caps gains – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale highlights that state-controlled banks in India have been actively selling Dollars for a second day after USD/INR briefly moved above its 50-day moving average.

item.title: CEE FX: Mixed PMI and inflation keep zloty capped – ING
item.description: Frantisek Taborsky at ING notes diverging PMI signals in Central Europe, with strong Czech sentiment and weaker Poland, but still expects Polish growth above 3% in 2026. Softer Polish inflation and a potentially dovish National Bank of Poland outlook are reflected in modest rate-cut pricing.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Thursday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $59.92 per troy ounce, up 1.38% from the $59.10 it cost on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Upside potential builds – UOB
item.description: UOB strategist Quek Ser Leang highlights a constructive technical backdrop for the US Dollar Index (DXY), noting similarities with the 2021 and 2025 basing phases.

item.title: RBNZ: Policy pace and July hike – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ Prashant Newnaha expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) to raise the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 25bps to 2.50% at next week’s meeting, keeping policy too accommodative with the cash rate still below neutral.

item.title: Japan’s Finance Ministry declines to comment on the Yen's sudden spike
item.description: When asked about the sudden spike in the Japanese Yen (JPY), Japan’s Finance Ministry declined to comment, per Reuters.

item.title: Euro remains stronger against Canadian Dollar following Eurozone Unemployment Rate
item.description: EUR/CAD rises after two days of losses, trading around 1.6200 during the European hours on Thursday. The pair remains stronger as the Euro (EUR) holds ground following the release of the Eurozone Unemployment Rate, which came in at 6.2% in May, against the 6.3% expected.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Inflation signals strengthen – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank highlights solid Japanese activity data, with the manufacturing PMI at 54.8 and the Tankan business conditions index at its highest since 2003.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling gains strength against Euro – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists highlight that EUR/GBP has completed a Head and Shoulders pattern and broken below its neckline around 0.8610, now seen as initial resistance.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Consolidates below $68.00, lowest since February amid oversold RSI
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – enters a bearish consolidation phase near its lowest level since late February, set earlier this Friday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar rises as US Dollar holds losses ahead of US NFP data
item.description: USD/CAD has lost its recent gains from the previous day, trading around 1.4190 during the European hours on Thursday. Traders adopt a cautious stance ahead of the highly anticipated June Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.
